test_title: PYST 28: SSC CHSL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 09 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
Identify the figure in the options that when put in place of the question mark (?) will logically complete the series?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ff3808852ddd64799ecea176fa0f2cacfd05192bcf0f2bf694561e79ae92b7dc.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 
• **Top number = Bottom number + 2;**
 
• **Right number = Top number × Bottom number**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f3a6ca778b705368f48f777543d203df06c2f655ad5428eaf149f67059230a5e.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
